name: inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-zipdma-16w-fuzz
notes: trigger_writes and status_offsets repeat the values already used by configs/scenarios/inprocess-irq-pulp-timer-profile.json; the entry re-checks them against the timer register map and interrupt declarations
dma_window must not overlap the APB target window; the timer owns 0x40000000..0x40000fff
the timer declares 50 MHz, the CPU 50 MHz and the ZipDMA a nominal 1 Hz simulation rate, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives all three models

f1_program_words 16 declares a 16-word straight-line F1 program in the fixed trampoline slot; the firmware points x18 at the declared 64-byte data window and only LW/SW against x18 inside it are admitted.  This copy exists so real fuzz/fixed batches can use dependency-rich programs generated by myfuzz.fuzz.rv32_program (style "chains"), and was added with scripts/verify_f1_programs.py evidence under runs/stage2-fuzz-programs-20261101/.
